study_smarter_guide.note: Current official MCC Study Smarter guide launched April 2, 2026

important_metadata.source_documentation: MCC explicitly states that: objectives may overlap disciplines; categorization is not exhaustive; not all objectives are represented; non-Medical Expert roles apply across disciplines

six_disciplines: PHELO (Public Health and Ethical, Legal, and Organizational Medicine)

discipline_representation.note: Applies to exam composition, not necessarily to total question bank size

mapping_placeholder.reason: This canonical registry should be built directly from the current official MCC Study Smarter guide rather than from secondary sources. Each discipline mapping must record exactly which Study Smarter discipline list(s) contain each objective.
next_steps: Access current 2026 MCC Study Smarter guide from https://mcc.ca
Extract discipline assignments for each objective
Do NOT infer additional mappings beyond what Study Smarter explicitly lists

cross_discipline_relationships.note: Inferred cross-disciplinary relationships and non-Study-Smarter mappings belong in research/scope/cross_discipline_map.json, not in this file
cross_discipline_relationships.example: A vaccination question in pregnancy may naturally be OBGYN-specific; immunization principles may primarily belong to PHELO; pediatric vaccine counselling may appropriately live within Pediatrics

data_integrity_notes: Study Smarter mapping must be built directly from the official MCC Study Smarter guide. This placeholder documents the source requirements and cautions about interpretation. Actual mappings will be extracted deterministically from the official guide.
